entities.summary: Lieutenant-General Sir Denis John Charles Kirwan Bernard, was a British Army officer who commanded the 3rd Infantry Division shortly before the outbreak of the Second World War. He was also Governor of Bermuda and General Officer Commanding the Bermuda Garrison.
